notes: LED moving-head wash fixture (27x 40W RGBW LEDs), IP20 dry-location housing (the power connector itself is IP65-rated, but the fixture body is not). Weight 68.2 lb (31 kg); dimensions 18.7 x 11.49 x 22.93 in (459 x 292 x 583 mm) — not rack-mountable. No rackUnits/type set since none of the allowed category/type enums represent a lighting fixture; category defaulted to "other". Power connector "Seetronic Powerkon IP65" mapped to the closest listed id "powercon" (it is physically/electrically compatible with Neutrik powerCON TRUE1). Data I/O confirmed directly from the manufacturer's official User Manual (Rev. 11) product-overview diagram and Technical Specifications table (p.3 and p.64): "3- and 5-pin DMX in/out" ports and "two Amphenol XLRnet [RJ45] through ports" used for Art-Net/sACN/Kling-Net/RDM/WDMX. Ethernet port speed/grade is not published by Chauvet, so grade was omitted rather than assumed. Power spec table explicitly lists both a "Power input connector" and a "Power output connector" (both Seetronic Powerkon IP65) for daisy-chaining, confirmed for both US/Worldwide and UK/Europe variants. Cross-checked against chauvetprofessional.com product page and B&H search-result summary (B&H page itself returned HTTP 403 and could not be fetched directly), both consistent with the manual.
